description: This file implements a TCP socket server class 'SocketServer' with methods for opening a socket, accepting connections, reading/writing data, and handling communication protocols including specific message headers and response handling. It also defines related data structures and enums for command IDs and message headers.

classes.name: Response
classes.description: Represents a response message with a channel ID and JSON payload.

classes.name: SocketServer
classes.description: Implements a TCP socket server for handling client connections, message exchange, and communication protocol.

methods.name: Response()
methods.description: Default constructor initializing channel_id to 0 and json to empty.

methods.name: Response(uint32_t, const string&)
methods.description: Constructor initializing with specific channel ID and JSON string.

methods.name: ~SocketServer()
methods.description: Destructor that closes the server socket and cleans up.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Sets up the server socket, binds to address and port, and starts listening for connections.

methods.name: RunThread
methods.description: Creates a thread to run the server loop.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Main server loop accepting connections and reading responses.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes server and client sockets, stops server loop.

methods.name: ReadExact
methods.description: Reads an exact number of bytes from the client socket.

methods.name: SendInvoke
methods.description: Sends an invoke command with channel ID, token, and JSON payload.

methods.name: SendAttach
methods.description: Sends an attach command with channel ID and attach flag.

methods.name: SendExit
methods.description: Sends an exit command to terminate the connection.

methods.name: ReadResponse
methods.description: Reads a response header and payload from the client socket.
